source_of_truth.library_access: reference identifiers only; local GEEHUB cannot query ChatGPT Library directly
source_of_truth.policy: Preserve library originals. Export only deliberately selected files to the user's Dropbox-synced working folder before local staging. Never overwrite, move, or alter originals.

usage_policy.rights_status: unverified; confirm source rights before public/commercial distribution

assets.visual_notes: Close crop of an adult bearded male upper torso seated in a car. Direct chest projection and left/right volume dominate the frame; arms cross the lower chest and the crop provides limited shoulder and torso context.

Generated high-resolution companion to the car close-up. Useful for the rounded forward pec volume, central separation, surface detail, and close-camera scale. Treat the extreme spherical volume and perspective as a stylized target, not literal anatomical measurement.

Full-length adult bodybuilder reference with strong upper-body-to-waist contrast, chest mass, shoulders, arms, thighs, and visible foot-to-head scale. Use to judge global silhouette and proportion continuity, not as a single-region chest sculpt target.
Closer three-quarter crop of the same oversized bodybuilder design family. Useful for chest-to-deltoid transition, lateral pec contour, shoulder cap, arm scale, and garment interaction.

Warm, low-key standing pose with hands at the waist. Strong chest separation, upper-chest arc, deltoid connection, torso taper, and dramatic lighting. Treat as a reference image with unknown original rights and authorship.
Seated adult male in a fitted polo. Useful for shoulder width, arm mass, sleeve compression, posture, and how a large upper body reads through clothing; chest anatomy is not directly visible.
